name: Warlock Engineer
abilities:
More-more Warp Energy!: Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit, it was not set up this turn and it has not used a Move ability this turn Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Damage characteristic of this unit's Warplock Musket to 3 for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.
Sniper-master: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase Pick a visible enemy Hero to be the target. For the rest of the turn, this unit and friendly Warplock Jezzails units wholly within 13" of this unit can ignore the effects of the 'Guarded Hero' ability (Core Rules, 25.0) when picking the target for their shooting attacks.

name: Arch-Warlock
abilities: Overseers of the Enginecovens: If a friendly Skryre unit wholly within 13" of this unit uses the 'Covering Fire' command, no command points are spent.

name: Clawlord
abilities:
Cornered Rat: While this unit is damaged, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of its Warpforged Blade.
Gnash-gnaw on Their Bones!: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit Pick a friendly non-Hero Verminus Infantry unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Clawlord on Gnaw-beast
abilities:
Cornered Rat: While this unit is damaged, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of its Warpforged Halberd.
Cruel Commander: Your Hero Phase Pick a friendly non-Hero Verminus Infantry unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target. Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 5 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn.

name: Deathmaster
abilities:
Shadowy Killers: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
Running Death: While friendly Eshin units are wholly within 13" of this unit, they can use Shoot and/or Charge abilities even if they used a Run ability in the same turn.

name: Grey Seer
abilities:
Warpstone Shards: Your Hero Phase The next time you make a casting roll for this unit this phase, roll 3D6 instead of 2D6. This roll cannot be rerolled or modified.
If the casting roll is 13, the spell is successfully cast and cannot be unbound. After the effect of that spell has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.
If the casting roll is not 13, remove 1 dice of your choice from the casting roll and use the remaining 2D6 as the casting roll.

name: Grey Seer on Screaming Bell
abilities:
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Bulk is 4.
Altar of the Horned Rat: Friendly Skaven Infantry units have Ward (6+) while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
Peal of Doom: Your Hero Phase Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:
1 *Magical Backlash:* Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.
2-4 *Wall of Unholy Sound:* Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are within 13" of this unit.
5-6 *Apocalyptic Doom:* Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 13" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
Cracks Call: Your Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy unit that does not have Fly and is within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. If the casting roll exceeds the target's Move characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the casting roll and its Move characteristic.
Keywords: Spell

name: Grey Seer on Screaming Bell (Scourge of Aqshy)
abilities:
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Bulk is 4.
The Bell Tolls: If the current battle round number is odd, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly Skaven units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. If the current battle round number is even, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units that target a friendly Skaven unit while it is wholly within 13" of this unit.
Echoes of the Vermindoom: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Pick up to 3 visible friendly Skaven units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets. Heal (D3) each target.
Pealing Portal: Your Hero Phase Make a casting roll of 2D6. Until the start of your next turn, this unit counts as a friendly Gnawhole for the purposes of the 'Gnawhole Ambush', 'Tunnels Through Reality' and 'The Endless Vermintide' abilities.
Keywords: Spell

name: Lord Skreech Verminking
abilities:
The Thirteen-headed One: Your Hero Phase Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn. You cannot pick the same effect more than once per battle.
*Master of Dire Sorcery:* Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly Masterclan Wizards while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
*Commander of Vermin:* Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly Verminus units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
*Knower of Warp-tech:* Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly Skryre units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
*Deliverer of Weeping Blades:* Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Eshin units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
*Bringer of Plagues:* Add 1 to chanting rolls for friendly Pestilens Priests while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
*Shaper of Fleshcraft:* Heal (D3) each friendly Moulder unit wholly within 13" of this unit.
Terrifying Monstrosity: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy Infantry unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
• Subtract an amount equal to the roll from the target's control score until the start of your next turn.
Keywords: Rampage
The Dreaded Thirteenth Spell: Your Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Roll 13 dice. For each 5+:
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• You can return 1 slain model to a friendly Clanrats unit wholly within 13" of this unit.
Keywords: Spell

name: Master Moulder
abilities:
Lord of Flesh-grafting: End of Any Turn Pick another friendly Moulder unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target. Heal (3) the target.
Tyrannical Packmaster: Your Charge Phase Pick another friendly Moulder unit within this unit's combat range to be the target. Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

name: Plague Priest on Plague Furnace
abilities:
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Great Plague Censer is 2.
Corrupting Influence: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 13" of this unit.
Altar of the Great Corruptor: Friendly Pestilens units have Ward (6+) while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

name: Thanquol on Boneripper
abilities:
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Warpfire Braziers is 4.
Staff of the Horned Rat: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
Warp-amulet: End of Any Turn Heal (D3) this unit.
Boneripper Rampage: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3-5, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target.
Keywords: Rampage
Terrible Madness: Your Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. The target cannot use commands until the start of your next turn. In addition, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
Keywords: Spell

name: Verminlord Corruptor
abilities:
Lord of Great Plagues: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase If the unmodified chanting roll for a friendly Pestilens Priest this phase was 6, pick 1 of the following effects to apply:
*Crimsonweal Curse:* Pick an enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the battle, each time the target uses a Move ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on it after the Move ability has been resolved.
*The Neverplague:* For the rest of the battle, you can re-roll chanting rolls for friendly Pestilens Priests.
*Undulant Scourge:* Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target. Inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target.
Plaguemaster: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Give this unit 1 ritual point.
Keywords: Rampage

name: Verminlord Corruptor (Scourge of Aqshy)
abilities:
Foetid Features: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle:
*Noisome Halitosis:* Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's Plague Breath.
*Pestilential Seepage:* While this unit is damaged, you can re-roll chanting rolls for friendly Pestilens Priests while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
*Curdled Miasma:* While they are within 6" of this unit, enemy units are not visible to other enemy units more than 3" from them.
Seething Blight: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick a visible unit (friendly or enemy) wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the battle:
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons.
• If an ability would heal or return any slain models to the target unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.
• If the target is replaced and the replacement unit has 1 model, allocate damage points to that replacement unit equal to half X (rounding up), where X is its Health characteristic minus the number of damage points allocated to it (if any).
• If the target is replaced and the replacement unit has more than 1 model, half the models in that replacement unit (rounding up) are automatically slain.
Keywords: Rampage

name: Verminlord Deceiver
abilities:
Lord of Assassins: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly Eshin Infantry unit wholly within 13" of this unit If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
Burst From the Shadows: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 4+, you can pick a point on the battlefield within 13" of this unit and within 1" of any enemy units. Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of that point.
Designer's Note: *This ability allows the unit to set up in combat with a new enemy unit.*
Keywords: Rampage

name: Verminlord Warbringer
abilities:
Tyrant of Battle: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick up to 2 friendly Verminus Infantry units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets. The targets can each use the 'All-out Attack' or 'All-out Defence' command this phase even if that command has been used by a friendly unit this phase.
Killing Blow: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Pick a damaged enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of damage points the target has, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Keywords: Rampage

name: Verminlord Warpseer
abilities:
Divine the Future: While this unit is on the battlefield, add 2" to the distance friendly units can move when using the 'Always Three Clawsteps Ahead' ability.
Arch-Manipulator: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.
Keywords: Rampage
Hurl Scry-orb: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. This unit cannot use the 'Divine the Future' ability for the rest of the battle. Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Tectonic Splintering: Your Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
Keywords: Spell

name: Warlock Bombardier
abilities:
More-more Doom!: Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit, it was not set up this turn and it has not used a Move ability this turn Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Damage characteristic of its Doomrocket to D3+3 for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.
Explosive Payload: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.

name: Gnawhole
abilities:
Volatile Ground: Models can pass through this terrain feature but cannot be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.
Each time an enemy unit ends a move that passed through or across this terrain feature, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
Tunnels Through Reality: Your Movement Phase Pick a friendly Skaven unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 6" of this terrain feature to be the target. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of another friendly Gnawhole and more than 9" from all enemy units.
The Endless Vermintide: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn Pick a friendly non-Hero Skaven Infantry unit that has been destroyed to be the target. Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of a friendly Gnawhole and more than 3" from all enemy units.

name: Acolyte Globadiers
abilities: Gas Clouds: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's Poisoned Wind Globes for attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.

name: Clanrats
abilities: Seething Swarm: End of Any Turn You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

name: Doom-flayers
abilities: Whirling Doom: Any Charge Phase If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

name: Doomwheel
abilities:
Rolling Doom: Your Movement Phase This unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. This unit can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat.
Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Designer's Note: *This unit can use this ability even if it is in combat.*
Keywords: Core, Move

name: Night Runners
abilities:
Grappling Hooks: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase If this unit was not set up this turn, pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target. Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of the target and more than 3" from all enemy units.
Smoke Bombs: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit's attacks. Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, if this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.
Keywords: Core, Move, Fight

name: Hell Pit Abomination
abilities:
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Gnashing Teeth and Flailing Fists is 8.
Avalanche of Flesh: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy Infantry unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
Keywords: Rampage
Regenerating Monstrosity: End of Any Turn Heal (D6) this unit.
Too Horrible to Die: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:
1 *Dead:* This unit is destroyed.
2-4 *The Rats Emerge:* Roll a D3 for each enemy unit in combat with this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. Then, this unit is destroyed.
5-6 *It's Alive!:* This unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (D6) this unit.

name: Plague Censer Bearers
abilities:
Frenzied Assault: If this unit charged in the same turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
Enshrouding Fumes: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

name: Plagueclaw
abilities: Bubonic Barrage: Each time this unit uses a Shoot ability, if all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. If the result is equal to or less than the number of models in that enemy unit that were slain by attacks made by this unit's Plagueclaw Catapult this phase, that enemy unit has Strike‑last for the rest of the turn.

name: Rat Ogors
abilities: Unleashed Warp-fury: Any Combat Phase Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

name: Ratling Warpblaster
abilities:
More-more Warpstone Bullets!: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase If this unit is within the combat range of a friendly Skryre Hero, this unit's Hail of Warpstone Bullets has an Attacks characteristic of 6D6+3 instead of 3D6+3 for the rest of the turn. However, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made with this unit's Hail of Warpstone Bullets, inflict 1 mortal damage on this unit after the Shoot ability has been resolved.
Overwhelming Fire: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.

name: Stormfiends
abilities:
Grinderfist Tunnellers: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase Pick this unit if it is in the tunnels below and includes any models armed with Grinderfists. Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
Shock Gauntlets: Each time an attack made with this unit's Shock Gauntlets scores a critical hit, that attack scores D6 hits on the target unit instead of 1. Make a wound roll for each hit.

name: Stormvermin
abilities: Elite Bodyguard: Friendly Skaven Infantry Heroes have Ward (5+) while they are within this unit's combat range.

name: Warp Lightning Cannon
abilities:
More-more Warp Lightning!: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase If this unit is within the combat range of a friendly Skryre Hero, add 6 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Warp Lightning Blast for the rest of the turn.
However, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made with this unit's Warp Lightning Blast, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit after the Shoot ability has been resolved.
Warp Lightning Blast: Each attack made with this weapon in a single phase must target the same enemy unit. Each hit inflicts 1 mortal damage on the target and the attack sequence ends.

name: Warplock Jezzails
abilities: Warpstone Snipers: Your Shooting Phase If this unit has not used a Move ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's Warplock Jezzails for the rest of the turn.

name: Battle Traits: Skaven
abilities:
Too Quick to Hit-hit: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly Skaven Infantry and Cavalry units by Retreat abilities.
The Lurking Vermintide: Deployment Phase Pick a friendly Skaven unit that has not been deployed. Set up that unit in reserve in the tunnels below. It has now been deployed.
Keywords: Deploy
Splinters of the Vermindoom: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round You can use this ability if there are fewer than 3 friendly Gnawholes on the battlefield. Set up a Gnawhole on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all other terrain features.
Always Three Clawsteps Ahead: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase Pick a friendly non-Monster Skaven unit that is not in combat and was not set up this turn to use this ability. That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.
Gnawhole Ambush: Your Movement Phase Pick a friendly Skaven unit that is in the tunnels below to use this ability. Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Gnawhole and more than 9" from all enemy units.

name: Plague Priest
abilities: Feed on Pestilence: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for a friendly Pestilens unit wholly within 13" of this unit Give this unit 1 ritual point.

name: Plague Monks
abilities: Spreaders of Filth and Disease: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

name: Skabbik's Plaguepack
abilities:
Enshrouding Fumes: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.
Skritter: This unit's Skritter is a token. If you make a chanting roll of 1 for this unit while its Skritter is on the battlefield, you can remove its Skritter from the battlefield and then re-roll that chanting roll.

name: Spiteclaw's Swarm
abilities: Seething Swarm: End of Any Turn You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

name: Skittershank's Clawpack
abilities:
Sneaky Infiltrators: While each model in this unit is within 1" of a terrain feature, this unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.
Shadowy Killers: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

name: Brood Terror
abilities:
Warpstone Fumes: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.
Keywords: Rampage
Regenerating Terror: End of Any Turn Heal (D6) this unit.

name: Krittok Foulblade
abilities:
Foster Competition: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly Stormvermin units while they are wholly within 13"of this unit.
Doomfang: Any Combat Phase This unit has Strike-first for the rest of the turn but it cannot use commands this phase.
A Reputation For Cunning: Enemy Hero Phase You can pick 2 different eligible units to use the 'Always Three Clawsteps Ahead' ability this phase instead of 1, but at least 1 of those units must have the Verminus keyword.

name: Vizzik Skour, Prophet of the Horned Rat
abilities:
Fissures In Reality: Any Combat Phase Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Prophet of the Horned Rat: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase You can re-roll chanting rolls for this unit until the start of your next turn
Gaze of the Gnaw: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn:
• If this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a Fight ability, all of the target's attacks must target this unit.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target's combat attacks that target this unit.
Keywords: Rampage
The Death Frenzy: Any Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy unit within 13"of this unit or a visible friendly Skaven Infantry unit within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. If the target is an enemy unit, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
If the target is a friendly unit, it can use 2 Fight abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.
If the chanting roll was 12+, you can pick 2 targets instead of 1.
Keywords: Prayer

name: Plaguepack
abilities:
Plague Rat: This unit's Plague rat is a token. If you make an unmodified chanting roll of 1 for this unit while its Plague rat is on the battlefield, you can remove its Plague rat from the battlefield and then re-roll that chanting roll.
Enshrouding Fumes: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

name: Warlock Galvaneer
abilities:
More-more Warpvolt Doom!: Any Shooting Phase Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's Warpvolt Obliterator to be the target. Roll a D3 for each other enemy unit within the target's combat range. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
Lightning Master: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase Pick a friendly Warpvolt Scourgers unit within this unit's combat range to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Attacks characteristic of the target's Warpvolt Scourgers to 10 for the rest of the turn.

name: Warp-Grinder
abilities:
Tunnel Skulkers: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly non-Monster Skaven unit if those units have not been deployed. Set up those units in reserve in the tunnels below. They have now been deployed.
Keywords: Deploy
Warp-ambush: Your Movement Phase You can only use this ability if this unit is in the tunnels below. Roll a dice and pick one of the following effects.
• On a 4+, pick an enemy unit that is more than 6" from all other enemy units. You can set up this unit on the battlefield in combat with that enemy unit and not in combat with any other enemy units. Then, if another friendly unit was set up in the tunnels below with the 'Tunnel Skulkers' ability, you can set up that unit wholly within 6" of this unit, in combat with that enemy unit, and not in combat with any other enemy units.
• You can set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if another friendly unit was set up in the tunnels below with the 'Tunnel Skulkers' ability, you can set up that unit wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

name: Zikkit's Tunnelpack
abilities:
Ka-boom!: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. This unit's Tik Tik is a token. If this unit's Tik Tik is on the battlefield, remove it from the battlefield and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll and the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.
Tunneling Team: Deployment Phase Set up this unit in reserve drilling beneath the surface. It has now been deployed.
Keywords: Deploy
Tunnelpack Ambush: Your Movement Phase Pick this unit if it is drilling beneath the surface. Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

name: Anvil of Apotheosis: Skaven Hero
abilities:
Malicious Authority: Each time a friendly non-Hero Skaven unit wholly within 13" of this unit uses the 'All-out Attack' command no command points are spent.
Back-back to the Fray, Minions!: Each time a friendly Clanrats or Stormvermin unit wholly within 13" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
Unholy Ministrations: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Pick up to 3 friendly Moulder units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets. Heal (3) each target.
Festering Chanter: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Pick any number of enemy units within 6" of this unit to be the targets. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
One with the Shadows: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase Pick up to 3 friendly Eshin units wholly within 13" of this unit and not in combat to be the targets. Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units,
Incessant Tinkerer: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick up to 3 friendly non-Hero Skryre units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets. Inflict 1 mortal damage on each target, Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Moulder-beast's Monstrous Limbs is 3.
Blessed (Or Just Lucky): This unit earns D3 additional renown points after each Path to Glory battle.
Favoured Pack: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase Pick a friendly Clanrats or Stormvermin unit within this unit's combat range to be its bodyguard. For the rest of the battle, while the bodyguard is wholly within 6" of this unit, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by the bodyguard and this unit has Ward (4+).
Natural Swarm-Chief: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick a friendly Skaven unit wholly within 13" of this unit and not in combat to be the target. The target can move D6". It can move into combat.
Spiteful Opponent: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for each damage point it has.
'Lead' From the Back: Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a minimum of 1.
He Who Fights and Runs Away...: If this unit used a Retreat ability this turn, it cannot contest objectives for the rest of the turn.
Suitably Paranoid: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's attacks while it is within the combat ranges of any other friendly units.
Warp-Addled: Roll a dice each time you declare a command for this unit. On a 4+, unless you spend 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
Accelerated Regeneration: End of Any Turn Heal (D6) this unit.
Best-best Warpstone Spikes: Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell ability If this unit or a friendly Skaven unit wholly within 13" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit or that friendly unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per Spell ability.
Warp Lightning Strike: Each attack made with this weapon in a single phase must target the same enemy unit. Each hit inflicts 1 mortal damage on the target and the attack sequence ends.
Deafening Bell: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attack made by enemy units while they are within 13# of this unit.
Revolting Barrage: Each time this unit uses a Shoot ability, if all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. If the result is equal to or less than the number of models in that enemy unit that were slain by attacks made by this unit's Clawed Catapult this phase, that enemy unit has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.
Dealings with the Masterclan: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
Cleric of the Horned Rat: Add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.

name: Brood Terror (Scourge of Ghyran)
abilities:
Lend A Claw: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick up to 4 other friendly non-Skryre Moulder units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Loosely Attached Bladed Limbs for the rest of the phase for each target picked. Add 1 to hit rolls for the targets' attacks for the rest of the phase, including those made with Companion weapons.
Keywords: Rampage
Regenerating Terror: End of Any Turn Heal (D6) this unit.

name: Grey Seer on Screaming Bell (Scourge of Ghyran)
abilities:
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Bulk is 4.
The Bell Tolls: If the current battle round number is odd, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly Skaven units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. If the current battle round number is even, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units that target a friendly Skaven unit while it is wholly within 13" of this unit.
Echoes of the Vermindoom: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Pick each friendly Skaven unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets. Heal (D3) each target.
Gnaw Through Reality: Your Hero Phase Make a casting roll of 2D6. Until the start of your next turn, this unit counts as a friendly Gnawhole for the purposes of the 'Gnawhole Ambush', 'Tunnels Through Reality' and 'The Endless Vermintide' abilities.
Keywords: Spell

name: Gutter Runners
abilities:
Bomb Rats: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase This unit's Bomb Rats are tokens. If there are fewer than 2 friendly Bomb Rats next to enemy units, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit that does not have a friendly Bomb Rat next to it to be the target. Place this unit's Bomb Rat next to the target.
Detonate: End of Any Turn This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. Pick each enemy unit that has a friendly Bomb Rat token to be a target. Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within a target's combat range. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. Then, remove the target's Bomb Rat.

name: Deathmaster Crixxit
abilities:
Master of Assassins: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy Hero.
Shadowblood Cloak: Any Combat Phase Pick a visible friendly Eshin unit that has 2 or more models and that is wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of the target. This unit can be set up in combat.
Diversionary Assault: Your Charge Phase Pick a visible friendly Gutter Runners unit wholly within
13" of this unit to be the target. Add 2 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
